title: Jazz On Time
style: Jazz hip-hop with swung drums and a laid-back boom-bap pulse, slick upright bass, brushed kit accents, and smoky Rhodes chords; verse rides sparse bass and piano, pre-chorus opens with clipped horn stabs and filtered percussion, chorus hits with a chantable hook and gang vocal repeats; dry close-mic lead with doubled hook lines, ad-lib echoes, tape-worn transitions, and a glossy yet warm late-night mix, jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I hit the door on time
Shoes clean, shirt pressed right
You got that look again
Like the room might change tonight

Trumpet in the corner hums
Bass line walks your name
I caught your smile in the glass
Then the whole thing came

[Pre-Chorus]
Slow drag, then the snap
Heart on the count-in line
You lean in, I lean back
Say it like it’s prime time

[Chorus]
Jazz on time, jazz on time
808 on the line
Jazz on time, jazz on time
Jazz song dot com, baby

Jazz on time, jazz on time
Say it, let it rhyme
Jazz on time, jazz on time
Meet me right on time

[Verse 2]
Your laugh cuts through the smoke
Like a coin in a cup
I trace the edge of the beat
And you keep lifting it up

We don’t need much tonight
Just a name and a nod
One little swing of the wrist
And we break through the fog

[Pre-Chorus]
Slow drag, then the snap
Heart on the count-in line
You lean in, I lean back
Say it like it’s prime time

[Chorus]
Jazz on time, jazz on time
808 on the line
Jazz on time, jazz on time
Jazz song dot com, baby

Jazz on time, jazz on time
Say it, let it rhyme
Jazz on time, jazz on time
Meet me right on time

[Bridge]
Let the whole block hush
When the band goes low
I found a sweet spot there
Where the good things grow
